assay_conditions.assay: C. albicans biofilm formation assay with blapstin at 0.5x to 8x MIC.
assay_conditions.source_support: Primary text and Figure 8 report dose-dependent inhibition of biofilm formation; 8x the 7 uM C. albicans MIC gives 56 uM.
assay_conditions.caution: The paper does not use the literal MBIC label; DBAASP's MBIC label is retained as database terminology.

source_locator.source_note: Primary text and Figure 8 support biofilm inhibition at 8x MIC.

assay_conditions.assay: Established C. albicans biofilm disruption assay with blapstin at 0.5x to 8x MIC.
assay_conditions.source_support: Primary text and Figure 8 report dose-dependent disruption of established biofilms; 8x the 7 uM C. albicans MIC gives 56 uM.
assay_conditions.caution: The paper does not use the literal MBEC50 label; DBAASP's MBEC50 label is retained as database terminology.

source_locator.source_note: Primary text and Figure 8 support established-biofilm disruption at 8x MIC.

assay_conditions.assay: Human erythrocyte hemolysis assay with Triton X-100 positive control and saline negative control.

source_locator.source_note: Primary text reports little hemolysis at 56.25 uM and Figure 7A shows the hemolysis curve.

assay_conditions.assay: Human erythrocyte hemolysis assay.
assay_conditions.source_support: Primary text reports HC50 greater than 112.5 uM.

source_locator.source_note: Primary text reports the HC50 threshold and Figure 7A is the source figure.

assay_conditions.assay: CCK-8 assay after 24 h exposure in RAW 264.7 cells.

source_locator.source_note: Primary text reports no obvious cytotoxicity across the stated concentration range.
